delay is the most important optimization function for LSRs.
delay is a better optimization function for LSRs than the other optimization functions.
the delay optimization function is the best function for improving the energy efficiency of the CUT.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, by using delay as the optimization function, LFSR-based TPGs can be used to generate test patterns with low power dissipation and energy consumption and with low number of test vectors.
delay can be considered as a good optimization function for LSFs, which can be used for improving energy efficiency, reducing energy consumption and also decreasing test vector number.
LFSR's capability in reducing test power, energy consumption, delay and number of required test vector is dependent on the optimization function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the delay is an important criterion for LFSRs, which should not be neglected in the optimization function.
, in the design of a TPG, we must consider delay as an important optimization function, along with the number of test patterns.
